newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH TECH SECTOR BACK ON GROWTH TRACK -MINISTRY.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH TECH SECTOR BACK ON GROWTH TRACK -MINISTRY.

text.p: The Finnish electronics and electrotechnical industry returned to its growth track after a breather between end-1995 and spring 1996, the Ministry of Trade and Industry said in a report on Tuesday.
"After summer holidays, (the sector) returned almost to its previous growth track," the ministry said.
The report focussed on the outlook for small- and medium-sized companies in the sector, many of which are sub-contractors to telecommunications giant Nokia Oy .
Growth was particularly strong in electronics and there especially in data communications technology, it said.
"Growth expectations are the strongest in data communications equipment manufacture," it said.
"In the whole sector, the orderstock, production and investment are expected to grow. A third of companies see growing payrolls," it said.
The value of production in the electronics and electrotechnical sector grew over 25 percent in 1995 to 44 billion markka.
"The sector is very dependent on exports which accounts for 70 percent of its demand," it said.
Profitability in the sector was good in 1995, with net profits at eight percent of net sales and return on investment at around 25 percent, the ministry said.
